unit: Generated domain and application service behavior must have isolated unit coverage.
integration: Generated persistence and interface seams must have local mocked integration coverage.
contract: Generated API schemas and external mock adapter contracts must be contract-tested.
negative: Invalid dispute transitions, invalid evidence, and rejected live endpoints must be tested.
resilience: Idempotency, replay tolerance, and local adapter failure behavior must be tested.
security: PII redaction, input validation, and secret-free execution must be tested.
performance_smoke: Local smoke checks must cover bounded latency and non-production load assumptions.
replay: Audit-safe regeneration and dispute lifecycle replay must be represented.
audit: Generated audit trail, manifest evidence, and governance boundary checks must be represented.
